messages.content: Give me the schedule of Manchester United for the next 6 games in Premier League.

function.name: sports_team_get_schedule
function.description: Fetches the schedule of the specified sports team for the specified number of games in the given league.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

num_of_games.description: Number of games for which to fetch the schedule.

league.description: The name of the sports league. If not provided, the function will fetch the schedule for all games, regardless of the league.

location.description: Optional. The city or venue where games are to be held. If not provided, default that all venues will be considered.

message.reasoning_content:
The user wants the schedule for Manchester United for the next 6 games in the Premier League. I need to use the sports_team_get_schedule function. The required parameters are team_name, num_of_games, and league. The user specified "Manchester United" as the team, "next 6 games" so num_of_games = 6, and "Premier League" as the league. I should also consider location, but it's optional and not specified, so I can omit it.

Let me call the function with these parameters.
